property_summary: For every caller address, the reference contract requires msg.sender == depositorAccount (the public depositorAccount variable) to successfully execute setL1BlockValues; the mutant instead checks against a hard-coded DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT constant, so there exist callers for which the reference allows the call but the mutant rejects it (or vice-versa if depositorAccount differs).
change_summary: Change the require to check msg.sender equals the public variable depositorAccount (lowercase) to instead check against the constant DEPOSITOR_ACCOUNT (uppercase), so a different address is enforced before setting state.
